title: Integration of features into a whole explains conscious seeing

statements.text: The step from unconscious to conscious vision is best explained by the move from extracting low and high level features to integrating them into one organized, unitary percept. This also accounts for the integrated and differentiated character of experience.

sources.quote: is probably best explained by visual processing going from (low and high level) feature extraction toward integrating those features into a coherent and integrated whole
